source: docs/dev/design/K1-core.md §3.6 (proposed K1.1 budgets, min bytes). Decided unit: KiB = 1024 bytes (D21). Re-baselined 2026-11-18 after K1.4b's grid-liveness gate (+~110 B on read): oneFp columns raised 0.5 KiB (D21 amendment).
rule: Column by the Fp types in the variant's types (Half, K7.H, counts as one: its decoder is ~0.3 KiB): none -> float; one -> oneFp; two or more (Float+Fp8+FpN) -> floatFp8Fpn. Variants with slot or buffer share a budget. Options (sampler, outside) use their profile's budget. read with isActive: false uses read.isActive=false; sample and march with isActive: false use their profile budget. Variants with opt-in helpers (K1.7a) use '<profile>+helpers': the profile budget + 1 KiB. Variants with the 'nodeAverage' helper (K3.2, the sparse volume source's module) use 'march+nodeAverage': the march budget + 1.5 KiB (its leaf/lower average readers are ~1 KiB of vendored code). Variants with both 'nodeAverage' and 'fastTrilinear' (K3.2d, the sparse volume source's module with vdbSampleFast) use 'march+nodeAverage+fastTrilinear': the march+nodeAverage budget + 1.5 KiB (vdbSampleFast and its lower-node tap are ~1.2 KiB). 'fastTrilinear' alone counts as an ordinary helper (+1 KiB). K3.7: variants with the levelSet helper use 'march+levelSet'. P1.3/P1.4: profile majorant uses 'majorant' (brick and global: sample + the walk, K1-core §3.6) or 'majorant.nodeMax' (march + the walk). P1.5: reader 'lean' uses '<profile>.lean' (read.lean is the §3.6 K1.8 row; sample.lean and majorant.lean were set from the first measurement plus ~0.4 KiB).

columns.oneFp: + one Fp type (Fp4, Fp8, Fp16, FpN or Half, with or without Float)
